about: Surf South West has run lessons at Croyde Bay since 1996 and works from Croyde Burrows car park, right on the beach. Beyond half-day to five-day surf courses, it offers adaptive and SEN sessions, women's sessions led by female instructors, coasteering, surf-and-yoga weekends and instructor training.
offers: Half-day, two-lesson, weekend and five-day courses
Girls on Waves sessions with female instructors
School, corporate, stag and hen groups
where: Croyde Burrows Car Park, Moore Lane, Croyde EX33 1NZ
goodToKnow: Surfing England Training Centre of Excellence
